name: greenkarachi
description: GreenKarachi - B2B plant marketplace connecting plant buyers, nursery owners, businesses, plantation organizers, donors, and investors in Karachi, Pakistan

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.check: npm run check:client && npm run check:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
